settings.title: Size Guide
settings.subtitle: Performance Skins are designed for a snug, second-skin fit. Here's how to find your perfect size.
settings.snug_colors_note: These colors run slightly snugger than Light Grey. If you're between sizes in Dark Grey, Hot Coral, or Blue — size up.
settings.light_grey_note: Light Grey offers a slightly more relaxed fit compared to other colors. True to size for most customers.
settings.cta_note: Still unsure? Contact us and we'll help you find the right fit.

settings.title: Between Sizes? Size Up.
settings.description: The material conforms slightly over the first few wears, but won't stretch dramatically. A slightly roomier fit is always more comfortable than too tight.

settings.title: Narrow Feet
settings.description: Try wearing a thin sock underneath for a more secure fit. This fills the extra space without affecting grip performance.

settings.title: Second-Skin Fit
settings.description: They should feel snug on first wear — secure but not painful. The material has slight give and conforms to your foot shape over the first few sessions.

settings.title: Color Matters
settings.description: Dark Grey, Hot Coral, and Blue run slightly snugger than Light Grey due to material variations. Factor this into your size selection.

settings.question: What size Barreletics should I get?
settings.answer: Barreletics come in M (US 5-8) and L (US 8.5-11). Between sizes? Size up. Dark Grey, Hot Coral, and Blue run slightly snugger than Light Grey.

settings.question: Do Barreletics run true to size?
settings.answer: Generally yes, with a snug second-skin fit. Light Grey is the most relaxed fit. Dark Grey, Hot Coral, and Blue are slightly snugger — size up if between sizes in those colors.
